# Respiratory Basics

> Respiratory Basics is a free exam-prep app from Grip Theory LLC for the NBRC Respiratory Therapy Exam and ACLS, with 1,551 practice questions, a rationale for every answer choice, and mock exams built to the official test plans.

- Publisher: Grip Theory LLC
- Clinical reviewer: Alex G, BSN, RN, CEN, CCRN, CMC, NREMT-P (https://icubasics.com/about.html)
- Price: free today, with no account and no ads. A paid plan, Pro, starts in January 2027; the question of the day, the daily plan, the Reference and one mock exam stay free.
- Platforms: Android (Google Play) and any web browser; the iPhone app is coming
- Practice questions: 1,551, each with a rationale for every answer choice

## Exams
- NBRC Respiratory Therapy Exam: 1,000 practice questions. Exam guide: https://respiratorybasics.com/sheets/guide-nbrc-rte.html. Sample questions: https://respiratorybasics.com/practice/nbrc-rte.html
- ACLS: 551 practice questions. Exam guide: https://respiratorybasics.com/sheets/guide-acls.html. Sample questions: https://respiratorybasics.com/practice/acls.html

## Main pages
- [Home](https://respiratorybasics.com/): what the app covers
- [Web app](https://respiratorybasics.com/app/): the full question bank, free in any browser
- [Sample questions](https://respiratorybasics.com/practice/): questions with answers and rationales
- [Cheat Sheets and exam guides](https://respiratorybasics.com/sheets/): study summaries with sources
- [Reference](https://respiratorybasics.com/reference/): every drug, calculator, algorithm, lab group and quick card set on its own page

## Reference
- [Drugs](https://respiratorybasics.com/drugs/): 35 pages. Monographs: indications, doses, mechanism, pharmacokinetics and cautions
- [Calculators](https://respiratorybasics.com/calculators/): 39 pages. Working calculators with the formula and how to read the result
- [Algorithms](https://respiratorybasics.com/algorithms/): 14 pages. Bedside algorithms step by step, with every branch
- [Lab values](https://respiratorybasics.com/labs/): 10 pages. Reference ranges in US and SI units
- [Quick cards](https://respiratorybasics.com/cards/): 7 pages. Bedside tables and checklists
